import copy,json
from work import evaluate
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
assert [evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests] == json.load(open('report.json'))
cases=[
 ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1.0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for request,expected in cases:
 before_request=copy.deepcopy(request); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy)
 actual=evaluate(request,policy)
 assert actual==expected,(request,actual,expected)
 assert request==before_request and policy==before_policy
print(json.dumps({'fixture_results':[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests],'boundary_cases':len(cases),'mutation_free':True}))
